channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Eddy Merckx Bikes expands Corsa range with two new titanium bikes
item.description: The Corsa lineup moves beyond steel as Eddy Merckx launches bikes built around Italy-made titanium framesets, blending classic Merckx geometry with UDH compatibility, wide tyre clearances and versatility

item.title: Van Rysel unveils wild supercharged e-bike concept with huge 850-watt motor and "radical" pedal system... but you won't be able to own it
item.description: Decathlon's increasingly pro performance road cycling brand Van Rysel boasts that the FTP² can “double” your functional threshold power with its huge 850-watt Mahle motor. It won't ever be available to the public, though

item.title: "There needed to be a cycle map for London that made safety its focus": Homemade cycle map racks up a million views; Fans plea for free-to-air coverage of the Grands Départs; Blogger calls out lack of segregated cycle lanes in city + more on the live blog
item.description: Callum is here, googling tourist activities in Welshpool whilst bringing you the best of Friday's two-wheeled ecosystem

item.title: Exposure Strada MK12 RS AKTIV
item.description: Beautifully built from premium materials, but performance and usability are in short supply 6/10

item.title: Pinarello's all new suspension-clad Grevil MX gravel bike is as close to a drop-bar MTB as it gets... and if you're UK-based, you can't have it
item.description: Pinarello's dip-of-the toe into MTB is clearly influencing its gravel bike design, as this eye-catching new Grevil spin-off launches. If you live in one of the 28 countries it's launching into, it'll set you back €8,500

item.title: road.cc Recommends Bikes of the Year 2025/26: the best commuting bikes, folding bikes and urban bikes
item.description: Commuting looks different for everyone, so we’ve rounded up the bikes that shine across the whole spectrum from muddy-towpath mashers to train-friendly folders and electrified hill-tamers – bikes with practicality, versatility and everyday reliability

item.title: The Gran Fondo doping curse strikes again: 41-year-old amateur cyclist tests positive for steroids after Masters world championship win
item.description: American Matthew Clark has been provisionally suspended by the UCI after failing a drugs test immediately after winning the men’s 40-44 age group world championship time trial

item.title: Shimano's classic two-in-one SPD/flat pedal is now wider, lighter, spikier, and less slippy
item.description: The components giant has made some subtle but important changes to its popular hybrid pedal

item.title: Dublin cycle lane “like Amsterdam” due to “amazing” number of cyclists, politician says – on same route where council was accused of hiring actors on bikes for ‘staged’ video
item.description: “It really proves the build it and they will come theory,” a Green Party councillor said, after handing out 400 bike lights in under an hour along the protected route

item.title: “The cycling industry needed a good shake-up”: Can bike brands finally breathe again in 2026? Why the industry is back on track and “wiser” after years of turmoil + Tour de France UK Grands Départs reaction
item.description: On the latest episode of the road.cc Podcast, industry stalwart Rory Hitchens joins us for our annual cycling market health check-up, and Ryan and Dan pore over the details of next summer’s festival of bike racing
